body.x: SECONDGROUND has displayed sports video recording information system in CES 2019‘Design & Source & MIK NIGHT’, the world’s largest technology show held in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to 11 (Fri).
SECONDGROUND not only professionally record and analyze social sports but also provide various service based on the analysis in order to satisfy the demand of records of the social sportsperson.

It allows real-time broadcast messaging service about social sports through record input platform, record analyzing service, media broadcasting service, and etc.; it aims to grow as a worldwide platform for sharing and recording documents of social sportspeople around the world.
Through this exhibition, SECONDGROUND has added functions that link the platform with different kinds of existing camera and smartphone camera, which enhanced the mobility of the system.

The features of sports video recording information system are simple input system, data linked with the server that data is not lost since it is automatically saved, real-time analysis of the record which provides diverse service related to record of participation by player, power analysis, and odds calculation; self-manufactured YouTube streaming system for social sports broadcasting, appearance of documented record on scoreboard, broadcasting through voice, and good transmission of broadcast when streaming as well as usage of many cameras and automatic revolution are other features of this system.
